title.zh: 在莱特省增设两个区域审判法院分庭，设于塔克洛班市，为此修订第129号国民议会法（即经修正的1980年《司法重组法》）第14条第(I)款并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Creating Two Additional Regional Trial Court Branches in the Province of Leyte to be stationed in the City of Tacloban Amending for the purpose Section 14 Paragraph (I) of Batas Pambansa Blg. 129, Otherwise known as the Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980, as amended, and appropriating funds therefor

text.en:
Section 14, paragraph (i) of Batas Pambansa Blg. 129, otherwise known as the "Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980", as amended, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 14. Regional Trial Courts.
"x x x "(e) Forty-three Regional Trial Judges shall be commissioned for the Eight Judicial Region.
There shall be:
"x x x "Nineteen branches with seats thereat for the Province of Leyte, the Province of Biliran, and the cities of Ormoc and Tacloban, with seats at Tacloban City, Abuyog, Calubian, Ormoc City, Carigara, Baybay, Burauen, Naval, Palompon, Hilongos, and Caibiran:
"x x x."
The Supreme Court shall assign the two additional branches of the regional trial court in the City of Tacloban, Province of Leyte in accordance with this Act.

The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, in coordination with the Secretary of the Department of Justice, shall immediately include in the court's program the operationalization of the additional regional trial court branches in the Province of Leyte, with station at the City of Tacloban, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
